answer_1.quote: Beyond natural language understanding tasks, our study expanded to include experiments on natural language generation tasks. These experiments were conducted using the GPT-2 medium (355M) and large (774M) models on the E2E NLG Challenge.

answer_2.quote: we adhered to the official evaluation script to compute BLEU , NIST , METEOR , ROUGE-L and CIDEr scores.

answer_3.quote: AlpacaEval is an automated evaluation benchmark for LLMs, employing GPT-4 as an annotator to compare the responses generated by the models against reference answers. MT-Bench ... GPT-4 was also used to evaluate the responses generated by the models.
